policy.goal: Move forward from spawn toward the nearby bullets at world x=-7,z=-2. Stop once player z is -1.5 or below. This is a short movement/pickup debugging probe, not combat.
policy.instructions: Use ordinary movement only. World forward starts toward negative Z. Select lateral correction only if needed. Read current position and facing from spatial.map observation. Readout is product-authored text. Do not continue into combat after reaching the target.

tactics.description: Hold W for 350ms to advance along current facing (initially negative Z).
Hold A for 200ms to strafe left relative to current facing.
Hold D for 200ms to strafe right relative to current facing.
Hold S for 200ms to move backward.
